metadata.description: Dual data center network topology with active/standby load balancing and failover. Each data center has a DMZ (firewall + load balancer) and an internal LAN (web app, auth/IAM, database). The global load balancer routes live traffic to DC1 and fails over to DC2. Databases and IAM replicate continuously between DCs

elements.name: User Clients
elements.description: End users accessing the web application via browser over HTTPS

elements.name: Global Load Balancer
elements.description: DNS-based / anycast global traffic manager. Routes requests to DC1 (active) and DC2 (failover)

elements.name: Data Center 1 — Primary
elements.description: Primary data center. Serves live traffic in normal operation

elements.name: DMZ
elements.description: Demilitarised zone in DC1. Exposes only the firewall and load balancer to external traffic

elements.name: Firewall DC1
elements.description: Stateful firewall in DC1 DMZ. Filters inbound HTTPS traffic from the global load balancer

elements.name: Load Balancer DC1
elements.description: Application load balancer in DC1 DMZ. Distributes HTTPS traffic to DC1 web application servers

elements.name: Internal LAN
elements.description: Internal LAN in DC1. Hosts application servers and databases, isolated from the DMZ

elements.name: Web App 1
elements.description: Primary web application server. Handles authenticated requests forwarded by the DC1 load balancer

elements.name: Auth / IAM
elements.description: Primary auth and IAM service. Issues and validates session tokens for the web application

elements.name: PostgreSQL Primary
elements.description: Primary PostgreSQL database. Handles all read and write operations; streams replication to DC2

elements.name: Data Center 2 — Standby
elements.description: Standby data center. Receives replicated data continuously; promoted to active on DC1 failure

elements.name: DMZ
elements.description: Demilitarised zone in DC2. Ready to accept live traffic on failover activation

elements.name: Firewall DC2
elements.description: Stateful firewall in DC2 DMZ. Filters failover HTTPS traffic from the global load balancer

elements.name: Load Balancer DC2
elements.description: Application load balancer in DC2 DMZ. Distributes traffic to DC2 web application servers on failover

elements.name: Internal LAN
elements.description: Internal LAN in DC2. Hosts standby application servers and replica databases

elements.name: Web App 2
elements.description: Standby web application server. Serves live traffic when DC2 is promoted to active

elements.name: Auth / IAM Replica
elements.description: Replica auth and IAM service. Stays in sync with DC1 primary; provides auth locally on failover

elements.name: PostgreSQL Replica
elements.description: Standby PostgreSQL replica. Receives streaming replication from DC1 primary; promoted to read-write on failover

relationships.label: Failover route
relationships.note: Dashed — standby path; activated on DC1 failure

relationships.label: Encrypted WAN
relationships.note: Bidirectional inter-DC link for replication traffic
